item.title: From text to token: How tokenization pipelines work
item.description:
📝 Splitting Text Into Searchable Pieces with Tokenization The tokenization phase takes our filtered text and splits it up into indexable units. This includes simple whitespace tokenizers that split on spaces, as well as more sophisticated language-aware tokenizers that understand non-English character sets2. These can be essential when your content contains non-prose text that needs special handling.
🔗 Read more: https://www.paradedb.com/blog/when-tokenization-becomes-token
